title: Verify native Admin order visibility and manual payment projections
verify: A real native order fixture exposes contacts, ordered products, delivery address/method, payment method, payment status, order status, total, and logical checkout_state through the native Admin order detail boundary.

The installed dashboard mechanism is verified: metadata is present in the order detail fields, `showMetadata`/`showJSON` and the metadata editor are available, and native `paymentCollection.markAsPaid(...)` and `order.cancel(...)` are the operator actions.
Admin actions and lifecycle events preserve the required fields while moving paid -> processing -> completed and terminal unpaid cancellation/refund projections.
The acceptance path uses existing Medusa Admin/native workflows and does not add a custom Admin replacement, direct database browser route, or alternate order record.
Fixtures and evidence are cleaned up and contain no real PII, provider payloads, credentials, cookies, tokens, or production data.
T3 verification records semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: Native Medusa/PostgreSQL Admin-compatible order detail payload with all required operator fields.
Operator lifecycle projection and field-preservation assertions across payment, fulfillment, completion, cancel, and refund fixtures.
Fixture cleanup, privacy scan, typecheck/build/lint output, and full T3 closure evidence.
constraints: Exercise the native Medusa order/payment/fulfillment/Admin-compatible boundary with synthetic data.
Keep all required data on native order/payment/fulfillment records and merged metadata; no custom Admin or order read model.
Do not use production data, live provider mutation, secret values, cookies, bearer values, OAuth tokens, or session identifiers in evidence.
invariants: Admin-visible order data remains available across lifecycle transitions.
Payment method/status and logical/native order status cannot be silently dropped or replaced with client values.
Acceptance cleanup is unconditional and does not affect unrelated orders or inventory.
purpose: Prove that the native Admin-compatible order detail remains a complete operator projection while lifecycle state changes.
success_outcome: A real local fixture demonstrates all required operator fields and native lifecycle projections without a custom Admin surface.
anti_goals: Do not build Admin UI or a custom order route.
Do not alter production order/payment behavior to make the fixture pass.
Do not include real customer or provider data in evidence.

forbidden_scope: custom Admin/storefront lifecycle UI or route
production data, secrets, credentials, tokens, cookies, direct stock mutation
stop_conditions: The native Admin-compatible boundary cannot expose one or more required fields.
Fixture proof requires a custom Admin replacement or direct database browser access.
Cleanup cannot be proven isolated from unrelated orders/inventory.
